costs.funding: MEXC funding history (longs pay positive rates)

TSMOM.name: Daily trend rider
TSMOM.desc: Long when the 30-day and 7-day returns are positive and price is above the 50-day EMA; short when all three point down. Trailing stop.
TSMOM.why: Made money after costs in both halves of the last year and over three years, and did better than random entries taken at the same moments. Settings are textbook defaults, not tuned to this data.

TREND_EMA.name: 4-hour trend crossover
TREND_EMA.desc: EMA 20 crosses EMA 100 on 4-hour bars with ADX above 20; long or short; trailing stop.
TREND_EMA.why: Made money after costs in both halves of the last year and over three years, and did better than random entries taken at the same moments. Settings are textbook defaults, not tuned to this data.

XSMOM.name: Momentum rotation
XSMOM.desc: Every day the 5 strongest coins of the last 14 days (per unit of volatility) are bought and the 5 weakest sold short, for 14 days.
XSMOM.why: Made money after costs in both halves of the last year and over three years, and did better than random entries taken at the same moments. Settings are textbook defaults, not tuned to this data.

XSMOM_7D.name: Momentum rotation, fast
XSMOM_7D.why: Breaks even at best after costs (+0.01R per trade over 893 trades): fees and slippage (0.02R a trade) eat whatever edge it has.

XSMOM_14D_7.name: Momentum rotation, 7-day hold
XSMOM_14D_7.why: Made money in one part of the year and lost it in the other (+0.11R vs −0.01R per trade): not reliable.

TREND_DC55.name: 4h 55-bar breakout
TREND_DC55.desc: Turtle-style breakout of the 55-bar high or low on 4-hour bars; trailing stop.
TREND_DC55.why: Over three years it was no better than random entries at the same moments (+0.02R ± 0.03).

TREND_DC20.name: 4h 20-bar breakout
TREND_DC20.desc: Breakout of the 20-bar high or low on 4-hour bars; trailing stop.
TREND_DC20.why: Breaks even at best after costs (+0.02R per trade over 2,981 trades): fees and slippage (0.05R a trade) eat whatever edge it has.

DC20_D.name: Daily 20-day breakout
DC20_D.desc: Breakout of the 20-day high or low; trailing stop.
DC20_D.why: Positive in the last year (+0.06R) but not over three years (+0.01R).

DC55_D.name: Daily 55-day breakout
DC55_D.desc: Breakout of the 55-day high or low; trailing stop.
DC55_D.why: Positive in the last year (+0.05R) but not over three years (−0.03R).

EMA5_20_D.name: Daily fast EMA cross
EMA5_20_D.desc: EMA 5 crosses EMA 20 on daily bars; trailing stop.
EMA5_20_D.why: Over three years it was no better than random entries at the same moments (+0.04R ± 0.05).

EMA10_50_D.name: Daily EMA 10/50 cross
EMA10_50_D.desc: EMA 10 crosses EMA 50 on daily bars; trailing stop.
EMA10_50_D.why: Over three years it was no better than random entries at the same moments (+0.06R ± 0.06).

TSMOM_FAST.name: Daily trend rider, fast
TSMOM_FAST.why: Positive in the last year (+0.08R) but not over three years (+0.00R).

TSMOM_SLOW.name: Daily trend rider, slow
TSMOM_SLOW.why: Breaks even at best after costs (−0.00R per trade over 282 trades): fees and slippage (0.02R a trade) eat whatever edge it has.

SQZ_4H.name: 4h volatility squeeze
SQZ_4H.desc: Bollinger bands at their narrowest in 30 days, then a close outside them with volume.
SQZ_4H.why: Loses money after costs: −0.13R per trade over 704 trades in the last year.

SQZ_D.name: Daily volatility squeeze
SQZ_D.desc: Daily version of the squeeze breakout.
SQZ_D.why: Over three years it was no better than random entries at the same moments (+0.01R ± 0.09).

RS_BRK.name: Relative-strength breakout
RS_BRK.desc: Coins beating BTC break a 10-bar high while BTC trends up (long); laggards break down while BTC trends down (short).
RS_BRK.why: Breaks even at best after costs (−0.00R per trade over 561 trades): fees and slippage (0.04R a trade) eat whatever edge it has.

XSREV_1D.name: 1-day reversal
XSREV_1D.desc: Buy the biggest 1-day losers, short the biggest winners, hold 1 day.
XSREV_1D.why: Loses money after costs: −0.03R per trade over 1,369 trades in the last year.

LIQ_FLUSH.name: Liquidation flush reversal
LIQ_FLUSH.desc: After a 3-ATR one-hour crash (or spike) on heavy volume, trade the snap-back.
LIQ_FLUSH.why: Loses money after costs: −0.15R per trade over 1,029 trades in the last year.

PULLBACK.name: Trend pullback
PULLBACK.desc: 4-hour trend, 1-hour RSI pullback that turns back; target 2.5R.
PULLBACK.why: Loses money after costs: −0.16R per trade over 1,901 trades in the last year.

FAIL_BRK.name: Stop-hunt fade
FAIL_BRK.desc: A new 48-hour high (low) that closes back inside with a long wick: trade against it.
FAIL_BRK.why: Loses money after costs: −0.08R per trade over 9,322 trades in the last year. It is slightly positive before costs (+0.02R), but fees, slippage and funding take 0.09R of every trade.

VOL_SPIKE.name: Volume spike follow-through
VOL_SPIKE.desc: An hour with 5x normal volume and a big body closing near its extreme: follow it.
VOL_SPIKE.why: Most of its profit came early in the year (+0.42R per trade); in the last 4 months it made only +0.04R, and a few big winners carry the total.

BTC_LEAD.name: BTC lead, alts catch up
BTC_LEAD.desc: After a big 1-hour BTC move, alts that have not followed yet (for their beta) catch up.
BTC_LEAD.why: Breaks even at best after costs (+0.00R per trade over 404 trades): fees and slippage (0.05R a trade) eat whatever edge it has.

FUND_FADE.name: Crowded funding fade
FUND_FADE.desc: Very positive funding while price stalls: short; very negative funding while price holds: long.
FUND_FADE.why: Breaks even (−0.01R per trade over 706 trades) even though funding payments work in its favour: no edge.

FUND_CARRY.name: Funding carry
FUND_CARRY.desc: Short the coins paying the highest funding, long the most negative, 24 hours.
FUND_CARRY.why: Loses money after costs: −0.02R per trade over 2,752 trades in the last year.
